attr.title: Deep Dungeons of Doom
attr.desc: A dungeon crawler about timing attacks, defending and choosing equipment. This experimental port uses Ruffle and requires a purchased Windows copy. Prepared for the original TrimUI Brick with NX Redux; other devices and firmware are unverified.
attr.inst: Unpack setup/ddd-preparation-tools.zip on a Windows PC with PowerShell 7.2 or later. Follow README.md to prepare your purchased game, then copy the generated ddd.swf into ports/deepdungeonsofdoom. Install WestonPack 0.2 through PortMaster. The current build has been tested on the original TrimUI Brick with NX Redux. No Steam client is required on the handheld.
